text: Success will always be way more about your behaviors than your thoughts.
Because a lot of the thoughts I have suck during the day, but I still get what is necessary done.
You have to have small daily victories of integrity.
It's, you know what, I did some good today.
I said I was going to shower and I showered.
I said I was going to go to the gym and I went to the gym.
I said I was going to call my mom, I called my mom.
I said I was going to write the first page and I wrote the first page.
And it's these small acts of integrity that improves our thoughts.
More than wishing our thoughts were different thoughts.
